title: Ordinary completed open pullback, adjunction and strict-system identity
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use the completed coefficient system [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], its exact open extension and adjunction [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], and the ordinary derived open extension and normalized identity comparisons of [def-zl-ordinary-open-support-normalization]. Define ordinaryOpenPull as the completed-ring derived pullback [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] along $j$, using the specified completed coefficient inverse-image identification. Define ordinaryOpenAdjunction as the exact derived open adjunction between ordinaryOpen and ordinaryOpenPull, with the termwise unit and counit of that specified module adjunction. For the strict quotient systems and their realized operations [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization], with normalized reconstruction unit [def-sf-integral-comparison-system-data], define systemDirectId as uniqueness of right adjoints applied to the system pullback adjunction after the normalized identity pullback comparison. These three names denote these constructions, not assertions of existence of arbitrary comparisons.
